about_the_game:
Sliding Knight is a calm yet mentally challenging 3D puzzle game.
Control a small knight who slides across the board, defeat or outsmart enemies in different dungeons, and find your way to the exit. Each map is filled with new traps and challenges; every move is critical to reaching the goal.

The aim isn’t just to advance, but to discover the right route — every slide is an experiment, every stop a chance to think.
It looks simple, but demands attention; a balance you can sink into even after a long day.

With its tranquil atmosphere, Sliding Knight takes you through forests, snowy mountains, and scorching deserts. Each region has its own mood; the minimalist look and soothing music create a clear-headed puzzle experience.

Sliding Logic:
The knight slides in the chosen direction and won’t stop until hitting an obstacle. Every move must be planned with care. Finding the correct route is the core of each level.

Move Limit:
Each stage gives you a limited number of moves. That limit turns even a simple-looking map into a strategic challenge.

Enemies & Traps:
Some dungeons contain enemies. Some attack directly, others control space. It’s up to you to defeat them or slip past with wit.
Traps like burning tiles, spikes, and moving hazards test your timing.

Camera Control:
Adjustable camera angle and zoom for a more comfortable analysis of each level.

Simple Controls, Deep Puzzles:
Played with just a few keys, yet every stage holds dozens of solution paths.
Your goal is to reach the exit with as few moves as possible — or simply enjoy the satisfaction of finding the solution.

With relaxed, accessible mechanics you’ll adapt quickly. Ready to begin the journey? Then take up your blade and start delving into the dungeons…


Once in a century, an ancient temple opens in the depths of the kingdom.
In the silence of stone dungeons, the only sound is the echo of your steps.
Legends say this is where true knights are born.

You are the latest heir to that tradition.
Not your sword but your mind will lead you out.
Each chamber you slide through tests your patience and intuition.
Every foe, every trap is less about the road ahead than the self within.

At the end of the path awaits not a throne — but a truth.
For in this trial, the mind is the realm to be conquered.
You will dive deeper with every slide, and draw closer with every depth…
until you reach the place where the light fades.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 / Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.4 GHz) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or NVIDIA GTX 550 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 800 GB available space

short_description: A charming low-poly puzzle game where you slide through strategic levels with limited moves. Every step is a challenge, and every move must be planned!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Turkish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Azerbaijani
